startup_tutorial.title: Welcome to Arbor!
startup_tutorial.text:
This quick 2-minute tutorial will show you the basics.

You can skip this now and access it anytime from the Help menu.

startup_tutorial.title: Excel Database
startup_tutorial.text:
Arbor uses an Excel file as its main database.
Select the file containing your botanical records here.

startup_tutorial.title: Image Source
startup_tutorial.text:
Choose where Arbor should load images from.
Online is recommended if you have a stable connection.

startup_tutorial.title: Launch System
startup_tutorial.text:
When you're ready, click here to load your project.
The tutorial will continue in the main workspace.

main_tutorial.title: Main Workspace
main_tutorial.text:
Welcome to the main Arbor interface.
Here you will review and edit your object records.

main_tutorial.title: Finding Objects
main_tutorial.text: Use the search bar to quickly find an object by its ID, genus, or other fields.

main_tutorial.title: Object Editor
main_tutorial.text: This panel lets you view and modify all properties of the selected object.

main_tutorial.title: Identifying Errors
main_tutorial.text: If an object has taxonomic or data errors, they will be flagged here for your review.

main_tutorial.title: Historical Conflicts
main_tutorial.text: If there are discrepancies with older data (or if you just want to compare), click this area to open the Historical Database Conflict Resolver.

main_tutorial.title: Mark as Reviewed
main_tutorial.text: Once you have corrected any errors, click this to mark the object as fully reviewed.

main_tutorial.title: Tutorial Complete
main_tutorial.text:
You're all set!

Remember, you can restart this tutorial anytime from Help -> Tutorial.

historical_resolver.title: Historical Conflict Resolver
historical_resolver.text:
Welcome to the Conflict Resolver.
Here you can see differences between the current record and older data.

historical_resolver.title: Field Directory
historical_resolver.text: This sidebar lists all fields that have a conflict or suggestion. Click a field to jump directly to it.

historical_resolver.title: Show All Fields
historical_resolver.text: By default, only fields with conflicts are shown. Check this to see the history for ALL fields in this record.

historical_resolver.title: Issue Cards
historical_resolver.text: These cards show the current value versus the historical values. Click a historical value to resolve the conflict by accepting it.

historical_resolver.title: Apply Changes
historical_resolver.text: When you are done resolving issues, click here to apply all of your selected resolutions to the record.

focus_settings.title: Focus Mode
focus_settings.text: Focus Mode helps you declutter the interface by hiding sections or fields that you don't need right now.

focus_settings.title: Presets
focus_settings.text: You can save different sets of visibility rules as 'Presets' and quickly load them here.

focus_settings.title: Dynamic Fallback
focus_settings.text: If a field has an error (problem flag), it will automatically reappear even if you hid it, ensuring you never miss a critical issue.

focus_settings.title: Visibility Toggles
focus_settings.text: Toggle individual fields or entire sections on and off. Uncheck a field to hide it from the main editor.

layout_settings.title: Layout Settings
layout_settings.text: Customize how Arbor's panels are arranged to best fit your workflow.

layout_settings.title: Saving Layouts
layout_settings.text: Once you configure your ideal layout, save it as a preset. You can load it instantly or even set it as your default startup layout.

layout_settings.title: Panel Toggles
layout_settings.text: Turn entire panels (like the Image Viewer, Search Bar, or Registration Fields) on or off using these toggles.
